_comment: Permission flow templates assembled from four public IAM privilege-escalation sources (pathfinding.cloud, PMapper, Pacu, Cloudsplaining; 'sources' lists which detect each path, 'ref' cites the pathfinding.cloud path id), cast into this project's flow-template format. These overlap heavily with the 219 unpublished templates of Hu et al., TAC (arXiv 2304.14540). Multi-step combinations (e.g. AttachRolePolicy+AssumeRole) are derived by the engine's chaining, so only atomic templates are listed.

templates.description: Add self to a group and inherit its permissions
Assume the role, or rewrite its trust policy to name yourself then assume it
Take over a user's credentials via iam:CreateAccessKey
Take over a user's credentials via iam:CreateLoginProfile
Take over a user's credentials via iam:UpdateLoginProfile
Grant permissions to a principal via iam:AttachUserPolicy on a managed policy
Grant permissions to a principal via iam:AttachRolePolicy on a managed policy
Grant permissions to a principal via iam:AttachGroupPolicy on a managed policy
Grant permissions to a principal via iam:CreatePolicyVersion on a managed policy
Grant permissions to a principal via iam:SetDefaultPolicyVersion on a managed policy
Write an arbitrary inline policy via iam:PutUserPolicy
Write an arbitrary inline policy via iam:PutRolePolicy
Write an arbitrary inline policy via iam:PutGroupPolicy
